title: A cikin gari
description: Ten short, simple stories about life in the towns and cities of Hausaland: a traffic policeman, a theatre group, the market, football, the university, a fire, a naming ceremony and more.

lessons.title: Ɗan sanda Murtala
lessons.summary: Murtala, a traffic policeman in Kano, stops a driver who did not halt at his signal and lets him go with a warning.
lessons.text:
Murtala ɗan sanda ne a Kano. Aikinsa yana kan wata babbar hanya a cikin birni. Motoci da yawa suna zuwa wannan hanya.

Akwai doka a wurin. Idan ɗan sanda ya ce "Tsaya!", dole mota ta tsaya. Doka ta hana mota ta wuce sai ɗan sanda ya ce "Ka wuce."

Wata rana, wata mota ta zo. Murtala ya ce, "Tsaya!" Amma motar ba ta tsaya ba. Ta wuce.

Murtala ya shiga motar 'yan sanda, kuma ya tafi maza maza. Bayan ɗan lokaci, sai ya ga motar a can gaba. Motar ta tsaya.

Murtala ya fito daga motarsa. Ya je wajen mai motar. Sunan mai motar Haladu.

"Ka ba ni takardun motarka," Murtala ya ce.

Haladu ya ba shi takardun. Murtala ya karanta takardun. Ya ga lambar motar a takarda. Lambar da take a takardar ita ce lambar da take a jikin motar.

"Me ya sa ba ka tsaya ba?" Murtala ya ce.

"Matata ba ta da lafiya," Haladu ya ce. "Tana can gida. Ina so in je wajenta maza."

Murtala ya ce, "Na ji. Amma doka ta hana ka wuce idan ɗan sanda ya ce ka tsaya. Kar ka sake yin haka."

"Ba zan sake ba," Haladu ya ce.

"To, ka tafi wajen matarka," Murtala ya gaya masa. "Amma kar ka manta da dokar."

Haladu ya tafi. Da Murtala ya koma wurin aikinsa, ya gaya wa wani ɗan sanda abin da ya faru.

Tambayoyi:
Murtala yana aiki a ina?
Yana aiki a kan wata babbar hanya a cikin birnin Kano.
Me motar Haladu ta yi?
Ba ta tsaya ba. Ta wuce.
Me Murtala ya gani a takardar?
Ya ga lambar motar a takardar.
Ina matar Haladu take?
Tana can gida, kuma ba ta da lafiya.
Me Murtala ya gaya wa Haladu?
Ya gaya masa, "Kar ka sake yin haka."

lessons.title: Zanen Zubairu
lessons.summary: A boy who loves the theatre in Kaduna paints a picture of the emir's palace for a drama group and becomes one of its members.
lessons.text:
Rukayya tana wasan kwaikwayo a Kaduna. Ita 'yar wata ƙungiyar wasan kwaikwayo ce. Shugaban ƙungiyar shi ne Sadiq. Kullum bayan aiki, ƙungiyar tana yin wasa a wani babban ɗaki a cikin birni. Mutane da yawa suna zuwa su ga wasan.

Wani yaro mai suna Zubairu yana zuwa kullum. Yana son wasan kwaikwayo sosai. Wata rana, bayan wasan, ya je wajen Sadiq.

"Me kake so?" Sadiq ya ce masa.

"Ina so in shiga ƙungiyarku," Zubairu ya ce.

"Me kake nufi? Kana so ka yi wasa tare da mu?"

"Ba haka nake nufi ba," Zubairu ya ce. "Ina yin zane. Abin da nake so shi ne in yi zane domin wasanku."

Sadiq ya yi mamaki. Ya ce, "Muna yin sabon wasa game da gidan sarki. Muna buƙatar zanen gidan sarki. Za ka iya yin zane irin wannan?"

"Zan iya," Zubairu ya ce. "Zan yi maka zanen."

"To," Sadiq ya ce. "Zan nuna maka abin da muke yi kullum."

Bayan kwana uku, Zubairu ya kawo wani babban zane. Zanen gidan sarki ne, kuma yana da kyau sosai.

Sadiq ya kira 'yan ƙungiyar, sai ya nuna musu zanen. "Kun ga zanen Zubairu?" ya ce musu.

"Mun gani," Rukayya ta ce. "Wannan ne abin da muke buƙata."

"Kun yarda ya zama ɗan ƙungiyarmu?" Sadiq ya ce musu.

"Mun yarda," suka ce.

Sadiq ya ce wa Zubairu, "Daga yau, kai ma ɗan ƙungiyarmu ne."

Yanzu Zubairu yana zuwa kullum, kuma yana yin zane domin wasannin ƙungiyar.

Tambayoyi:
Wa ne shugaban ƙungiyar wasan kwaikwayo?
Sadiq ne shugaban ƙungiyar.
Me Zubairu yake nufi?
Yana nufin yana so ya yi zane domin wasan.
Me Zubairu ya kawo bayan kwana uku?
Ya kawo zanen gidan sarki.
Me Sadiq ya nuna wa 'yan ƙungiyar?
Ya nuna musu zanen Zubairu.
Me Sadiq ya ce wa Zubairu?
Ya ce masa, "Daga yau, kai ma ɗan ƙungiyarmu ne."

lessons.title: Farar riga
lessons.summary: Khadija goes to the Kano market for a new dress for a wedding, and the seller lowers the price of the white one she loves.
lessons.text:
Jiya Khadija ta tafi kasuwa a Kano. Gobe za ta je wani taron aure, kuma tana son sabuwar riga.

Kasuwar tana da girma sosai, kuma akwai mutane da yawa a cikinta. A kasuwa akwai riguna da yawa, kuma launukansu iri iri ne.

Khadija ta je wajen wata mata mai riguna. Sunan matar Mairo.

"Ina son riga domin taron aure," Khadija ta ce.

Mairo ta nuna mata riguna da yawa, na launuka iri iri. Khadija ta ce, "Ina son farar riga."

Mairo ta nuna mata wata farar riga. "Ga wannan," ta ce. "Kuɗinta dubu goma."

"Dubu goma?" Khadija ta ce. "Kuɗina kaɗan ne. Ina da 8,000 ne kawai."

Mairo ta nuna mata wata baƙar riga. "Wannan baƙar riga dubu biyar ce," ta ce.

Khadija ta sa baƙar rigar. Amma launinta bai dace da ita ba. "Wannan launi bai dace da ni ba," ta ce.

Mairo ta ga cewa Khadija tana son farar rigar sosai. Sai ta ce, "To, zan ba ki farar rigar a kan 8,000. Na cire kaɗan daga kuɗinta."

Khadija ta yi farin ciki. Ta sa farar rigar. "Rigar nan ta dace da ke sosai," Mairo ta ce. "Allah ya sa ki ji daɗin taron."

Khadija ta biya 8,000. Ta biya kusan duk kuɗinta, kuma kuɗin da ya rage a hannunta kaɗan ne. Amma ta ji daɗi.

"Ki sake zuwa wurina," Mairo ta ce. "Ina da riguna masu kyau na dubu biyar zuwa dubu goma." Kusan kowace rana, Mairo tana kasuwa.

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe Khadija ta tafi kasuwa?
Ta tafi kasuwa jiya.
Me ya sa take son sabuwar riga?
Gobe za ta je wani taron aure.
Kuɗin farar rigar nawa ne da farko?
Kuɗinta dubu goma.
Baƙar rigar ta dace da Khadija?
A'a, launinta bai dace da ita ba.
Nawa Khadija ta biya a ƙarshe?
Ta biya 8,000, kusan duk kuɗinta.

lessons.title: Ƙwallo a fili
lessons.summary: Young men play football on a big field in Jos; Iliya is hit in the eye but plays on, and Hamisu's team scores four goals.
lessons.text:
A Jos akwai wani babban fili a tsakiyar gari. Kowace ranar Juma'a, matasa suna wasan ƙwallon ƙafa a filin. Mutane da yawa suna zuwa kallo.

Hamisu yana ɗaya daga cikin matasan. Yana gudu sosai. Iliya ma yana wasa a ƙungiyar Hamisu.

A wannan Juma'a, ƙungiyoyi biyu suna wasa a filin: ƙungiyar Hamisu da wata ƙungiyar matasa daga wani ɓangaren garin.

Da wasan ya fara, Hamisu ya yi gudu da ƙwallon. Ya ba Iliya ƙwallon, sai Iliya ya ci ƙwallo ɗaya.

Matasan suna taimakon juna. Hamisu yana ba Iliya ƙwallo, Iliya kuma yana ba Hamisu. Suna wasa tare, kuma suna gudu tare.

Sannan wani abu ya faru. Wani ɗan wasa ya buga ƙwallo, sai ƙwallon ya buga Iliya a ido. Iliya ya faɗi. "Idona yana ciwo!" ya ce.

Hamisu ya yi gudu zuwa wajen Iliya. Mutanen da suke kallo ba su ji daɗi ba. Hamisu ya ga idon Iliya. "Kana lafiya?" ya ce.

"Idona yana ciwo kaɗan," Iliya ya ce. "Amma zan iya ci gaba da wasa."

Iliya ya ci gaba da wasa. Bayan haka, Hamisu ya ci ƙwallo sau uku. Ƙungiyar Hamisu ta ci ƙwallo huɗu, ɗayan ƙungiyar kuma ta ci ɗaya kawai.

'Yan ƙungiyoyin biyu sun ba juna hannu. Mutanen da suke kallo sun ji daɗin wasan sosai. Da dare, idon Iliya ba ya ciwo.

Tambayoyi:
A ina matasan suke wasan ƙwallo?
Suna wasa a wani babban fili a tsakiyar Jos.
Me ya faru da Iliya?
Ƙwallon ya buga shi a ido, kuma idonsa ya yi ciwo.
Sau nawa Hamisu ya ci ƙwallo?
Hamisu ya ci ƙwallo sau uku.
Ƙungiyar Hamisu ta ci ƙwallo nawa?
Ta ci ƙwallo huɗu.

lessons.title: Tambayoyin Lubabatu
lessons.summary: Lubabatu studies languages at the university in Zaria, asks her teacher good questions and finishes her first year well.
lessons.text:
Lubabatu tana karatu a jami'a a Zaria, a fannin harsuna. Manufarta ita ce ta zama malama a jami'a.

Malam Hussaini yana aiki a jami'ar. Kullum yana ba ɗalibai bayani game da harsunan duniya. Yana ba da misali da yawa, domin su san abin da bayaninsa yake nufi.

Wata rana, Malam Hussaini yana bayani game da harshen Hausa. Ya ce, "Mutane da yawa suna magana da harshen Hausa a ƙasashe da yawa. Misali, ana magana da shi a Najeriya, a Nijar da kuma a Ghana."

Lubabatu ta ce, "Malam, ina da tambaya."

"Ki yi tambayarki," Malam Hussaini ya ce.

"Harsuna nawa ne a Najeriya?" Lubabatu ta ce.

"Tambaya ce mai kyau," Malam ya ce. "Amsar ita ce: akwai harsuna fiye da 500 a Najeriya."

Lubabatu ta rubuta amsar a littafinta. Sannan ta sake yin wata tambaya. "Malam, ka ba mu misali na harshe da yake da mutane kaɗan."

Malam Hussaini ya ba da amsa. "Misali, akwai wasu harsuna a jihar Bauchi. Mutane kaɗan ne kawai suke magana da su."

A ƙarshen shekara, Lubabatu ta kammala karatunta na shekarar farko. Ta samu sakamako mai kyau, domin ta san amsar kusan kowace tambaya.

Malam Hussaini ya ce mata, "Ƙoƙarinki yana da kyau. Idan kika kammala karatunki, za ki zama malama a jami'a. Manufarki ce mai kyau."

Tambayoyi:
Lubabatu tana karatu a fannin me?
Tana karatu a fannin harsuna.
Me Lubabatu take so ta zama?
Tana so ta zama malama a jami'a. Wannan ita ce manufarta.
Harsuna nawa ne a Najeriya?
Akwai harsuna fiye da 500 a Najeriya.
Me Lubabatu ta yi a ƙarshen shekara?
Ta kammala karatunta na shekarar farko.

lessons.title: Rahoton Rabiu
lessons.summary: Rabiu, a newspaper reporter in Abuja, writes a report with photos about homes without water, and the government promises to help.
lessons.text:
Rabiu wakilin wata jarida ne a Abuja. Aikinsa shi ne ya rubuta labarai game da birnin.

Wata rana, ya ji wani batu: a wani ɓangaren birnin, gidaje da yawa ba su da ruwa. Rabiu ya ce, "Zan je in ga ko da gaske ne."

Ya je wurin. Ya yi magana da mutane da yawa, kuma ya nemi ra'ayinsu. Wani mutum ya ce, "Da gaske ne. Mun yi kwana goma babu ruwa." Wata mata ta ce, "Yara ba sa zuwa makaranta da wuri, domin suna neman ruwa."

Yawancin mutanen sun ce gwamnati ba ta yin komai. Amma wani tsoho yana da ra'ayi daban. "A ra'ayina, gwamnati za ta taimaka mana," ya ce.

Rabiu yana son ɗaukar hoto. A wurin, ya ɗauki hoton yara da suke ɗaukar ruwa daga wani wuri.

Da ya koma wurin aikinsa, ya rubuta rahoto. A cikin rahoton, ya ce kashi 70 cikin 100 na gidajen wurin ba su da ruwa. A cewar wani mutum a wurin, "Mun yi kwana goma babu ruwa." A cewar tsohon, gwamnati za ta taimaka.

Jaridar ta buga rahoton Rabiu tare da hotunansa. Mutane da yawa sun karanta rahoton. Batun ruwan ya zama babban labari a cikin labaran birnin.

Bayan kwana biyu, gwamnati ta ce za ta kawo ruwa a wurin. "Rahotonka ya taimaka," wani mutum ya ce wa Rabiu.

Tambayoyi:
Me Rabiu yake yi a Abuja?
Shi wakilin wata jarida ne, kuma yana rubuta labarai game da birnin.
Me yawancin mutanen suka ce?
Yawancin mutanen sun ce gwamnati ba ta yin komai.
Rabiu ya ɗauki hoton me?
Ya ɗauki hoton yara da suke ɗaukar ruwa.
Kashi nawa na gidajen wurin ba su da ruwa?
Kashi 70 cikin 100 na gidajen wurin ba su da ruwa.
Me gwamnati ta ce bayan rahoton?
Gwamnati ta ce za ta kawo ruwa a wurin.

lessons.title: Wuta a gidan Iro
lessons.summary: A fire starts in old Iro's room in Katsina, and his neighbour Tasi'u goes in and carries him out alive.
lessons.text:
Iro tsoho ne a Katsina. Yana da shekara 80. Yana zama shi kaɗai a wani ƙaramin gida.

Lokacin zafi ne. Zafin rana yana da yawa sosai. Wata rana da rana, wuta ta kama a ɗakin Iro. Wutar ta yi girma maza.

Iro ya ji tsoro sosai. Ba ya iya fita, domin wuta tana kan hanyar fita. Sai ya shiga ƙarƙashin gadonsa.

Wani mutum mai suna Tasi'u yana zama kusa da gidansa. Tasi'u ya ga wuta a gidan Iro. Ya san cewa Iro yana zama shi kaɗai.

Tasi'u ya yanke shawara: zai shiga gidan. Mutane suka ce masa, "Kar ka shiga! Wutar tana da zafi sosai!"

Amma Tasi'u ya ce, "Iro shi kaɗai ne a ciki. Ransa yana cikin haɗari."

Tasi'u ya shiga gidan. Ya ga Iro a ƙarƙashin gadon. Ya ɗauke shi, kuma ya fito da shi waje. Ya kai shi ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya. Iro yana da rai.

Sannan 'yan kashe wuta sun zo, kuma sun kashe wutar. Babu wanda ya mutu.

Wani mutum ya ga duk abin da ya faru. Shi shaida ne. Ya gaya wa 'yan sanda, "Na ga komai. Tasi'u ya ɗauke shi daga cikin wuta. Shi ne ya kare ran Iro."

Iro ya ce wa Tasi'u, "Na ji tsoro cewa zan mutu a cikin wutar. Ka kare ni. Allah ya taimake ka."

Tambayoyi:
Iro yana zama da wa?
Yana zama shi kaɗai.
Ina Iro ya shiga lokacin da wutar ta yi girma?
Ya shiga ƙarƙashin gadonsa.
Me Tasi'u ya yi bayan ya ga wutar?
Ya yanke shawara zai shiga gidan.
Wani ya mutu a wutar?
Babu wanda ya mutu.
Me shaida ya gaya wa 'yan sanda?
Ya ce Tasi'u ne ya ɗauke Iro daga cikin wuta.

lessons.title: Bikin suna
lessons.summary: Nuhu and Zulai of Gombe hold a naming ceremony for their first son, and his grandparents come from Yola.
lessons.text:
Nuhu da matarsa Zulai suna zama a birnin Gombe. Bana Zulai ta haifa masa ɗansu na farko. An haife shi a gida, kuma uwar yaron tana lafiya.

Iyayen Nuhu ba sa zama a Gombe. Asalinsu daga Yola ne. Amma asalin iyayen Zulai daga Gombe ne.

A al'adar Hausawa, ana yin bikin suna kwana 7 bayan an haife yaro. Wannan al'ada ce mai daɗi.

Kafin bikin, kowa yana shiri. Zulai da uwarta suna shirya abinci. Nuhu yana kawo kayan biki. Iyayen Nuhu sun zo daga Yola. Ranar bikin, kowa yana shirye, kuma abinci ma yana shirye.

Mutane da yawa sun zo gidan Nuhu. Wasu sun zauna a waje. Mata sun zauna a cikin gida tare da Zulai da uwarta.

Wani malam ya zo. Ya yi addu'a, sannan ya ba yaron suna: Abubakar. Sunan mahaifin Nuhu ne.

Mahaifin Nuhu ya yi farin ciki sosai. "Yau ina farin ciki," ya ce. "Wannan yaro yana da sunana."

Bayan haka, kowa ya ci abinci. Uwar yaron, Zulai, ta zauna tare da ɗanta. Ta ce wa Nuhu, "Bikin nan ya yi kyau sosai."

"Haka ne," Nuhu ya ce. "Bana shekara ce mai kyau ga iyalinmu."

Tambayoyi:
Zulai ta haifa wa Nuhu ɗa a wace shekara?
Bana Zulai ta haifa masa ɗa.
Daga ina asalin iyayen Nuhu?
Asalinsu daga Yola ne.
A al'adarsu, ana yin bikin suna bayan kwana nawa?
Ana yin bikin suna kwana 7 bayan an haife yaro.
Wa ne ya ba yaron suna?
Wani malam ne ya ba yaron suna.
Malam ya ba yaron sunan wa?
Ya ba shi sunan mahaifin Nuhu, Abubakar.

lessons.title: Gidan abincin Mustapha
lessons.summary: Mustapha repairs an old house near the Maiduguri market step by step, opens a restaurant and does well.
lessons.text:
Mustapha yana zama a Maiduguri. Yana da sha'awar abinci sosai. Tun yana yaro, yana son ya buɗe gidan abinci.

Bana Mustapha ya samu wani tsohon gida kusa da kasuwa. Gidan yana da matsaloli da yawa.

"Zan gyara wannan gida," ya ce wa matarsa Fadila. "Sannan zan gina sabon ɗaki a bayansa."

Fadila ta ce, "Aiki ne mai wahala. Amma za mu yi shi mataki mataki."

Mataki na farko: Mustapha ya duba duk gidan. Ya duba kowane ɗaki, domin ya ga abin da yake buƙatar gyara.

Mataki na biyu: Ya gyara ɗakunan. Wasu ma'aikata sun taimaka masa.

Mataki na uku: Ya gina sabon ɗaki a bayan gidan.

Aikin yana da wahala. Wani lokaci ruwan sama ya hana su aiki. Fadila ta ɗauka cewa aikin zai ɗauki wata ɗaya kawai. Mustapha ma ya ɗauka haka. Amma aikin ya ɗauki wata uku.

A ƙarshe, Mustapha ya buɗe gidan abincinsa. A ranar farko, gidan abincin ya cika da mutane. Mutane da yawa suna da sha'awar abincinsa.

Yanzu kullum gidan abincin yana cike da mutane. Mustapha ya samu arziki. "Allah ya ba mu arziki," ya ce wa Fadila. "Duk wahalarmu ta yi amfani."

Tambayoyi:
Me Mustapha yake son ya buɗe?
Yana son ya buɗe gidan abinci.
Me Mustapha ya yi a mataki na farko?
Ya duba duk gidan.
Me ya hana su aiki wani lokaci?
Ruwan sama ne ya hana su aiki.
Me Fadila ta ɗauka game da aikin?
Ta ɗauka cewa aikin zai ɗauki wata ɗaya kawai.
Me ya faru a ranar farko?
Gidan abincin ya cika da mutane.

lessons.title: Tsuntsun Shu'aibu
lessons.summary: Old Shu'aibu of Bauchi lives alone with his late wife's bird; when his heart hurts, his friend Hamidu takes him for medicine.
lessons.text:
Shu'aibu tsoho ne a Bauchi. Bayan mutuwar matarsa, yana zama shi kaɗai. Amma yana da wani tsuntsu a gidansa. Tsuntsun yana yin waƙa kullum.

Shu'aibu yana da wani aboki mai suna Hamidu. Abokinsa yana zuwa wajensa kowane mako.

Wata rana, Hamidu ya zo gidan Shu'aibu. Shu'aibu ba ya jin daɗi. "Zuciyata tana ciwo," ya ce wa abokinsa.

Hamidu ya ji tsoro matuƙa. "Ka bi ni," ya ce. "Mu je gidan magani maza."

Shu'aibu ya bi abokinsa zuwa gidan magani. A can, wani likita ya ba shi magani. Likitan ya ce, "Zuciyarka ba ta da ƙarfi sosai. Ka sha wannan magani kullum. Kuma kar ka ci gishiri da yawa."

Sai suka dawo gida tare. Da suka dawo, tsuntsun yana waƙa. Shu'aibu ya ji daɗi matuƙa. "Ka ji tsuntsuna?" ya ce.

"Wane tsuntsu ne wannan?" Hamidu ya ce. "Waƙarsa tana da daɗi matuƙa."

"Tsuntsun matata ne," Shu'aibu ya ce. "Kafin mutuwarta, ta ba ni shi. Ina son shi sosai."

Hamidu ya ce, "Gobe zan dawo, in ga ko ka sha maganinka."

Daga wannan rana, Hamidu yana zuwa kowace rana. Kullum yana ce wa abokinsa, "Ka sha maganinka?"

Tambayoyi:
Shu'aibu yana zama da wa?
Bayan mutuwar matarsa, yana zama shi kaɗai a gidansa, tare da wani tsuntsu.
Wane aboki yake zuwa wajen Shu'aibu?
Hamidu ne yake zuwa wajensa.
Me ya sa Shu'aibu ya bi Hamidu zuwa gidan magani?
Zuciyarsa tana ciwo.
Me likitan ya ce wa Shu'aibu?
Ya ce ya sha magani kullum, kuma kar ya ci gishiri da yawa.
Wane tsuntsu ne a gidan Shu'aibu?
Tsuntsun matarsa ne. Kafin mutuwarta, ta ba shi tsuntsun.
